verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Sift as a risk-scoring/decisioning platform (scores, workflows, decisions, event ingestion) but contains no mention of a chargeback guarantee, liability shift, or reimbursement program with coverage terms — that is a distinct commercial product typically offered by payment/guarantee vendors. Missing for 10: any documentation of a financial guarantee/reimbursement program, coverage terms, liability-shift language, or contractual chargeback indemnification.
